uca_sentences: The man in the orange shirt walked to the middle of the shelf, and a man in the white shirt was behind him. They both stopped in front of the shelf.
The man in the white shirt took out something and touched the laptop. Suddenly something fell. He picked it up and put it under the laptop.
The man in white clothes closed the notebook, and then the man in orange clothes looked around
The man in orange clothes closed the computer and hid it in his clothes and walked away.
The man in white clothes closed the other computer, hid it in his clothes and walked away
The man in white clothes and the man in orange shirt talked at the end, and then went out

witness_A.viewpoint: close by, inside, a few metres away
witness_A.statement: I was standing close by when I saw a man who looked around, not sure if he was wearing an orange shirt. He walked to the middle of the shelf, hid something in his clothes, and then walked away. Another man stopped in front of the shelf, touched a laptop, picked it up, put it under the laptop, closed the other computer, and then talked at the end.

witness_B.viewpoint: far away, looking in from outside
witness_B.statement: I saw a man wearing an orange shirt who hid something in his clothes. Another man, possibly wearing a green shirt, took out something, picked it up, put it under the laptop, and hid it in his clothes. He then went out. I'm not sure if he was wearing a green shirt or if he closed another computer and talked at the end.

witness_C.statement: I saw a man who hid something in his clothes and walked away. I think he was wearing an orange shirt. Another man stopped in front of the shelf, touched the laptop, picked it up, closed the other computer, and hid it in his clothes. A white van was also there.
